channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: Kiera and Josh moved to Florida for their careers, but when Kiera was pregnant with their second child, they realized they needed to be closer to family. After buying their first house, they quickly discovered it wasn't big enough. Now they are searching for a home that can accommodate their growing family, keep them near the beach, and give them the space they need to run their business and raise their two young daughters.
